item.title: Brandi Carlile Postpones U.K. and European Tour Citing ‘Personal Circumstances’
item.description:
Here's a short, engaging podcast script based on the article:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome back to the show, music lovers! We've got some updates on Brandi Carlile's upcoming tour. Unfortunately, the singer-songwriter has announced that she's postponing her UK and European leg, citing 'personal circumstances'."
[Short music transition]
Host: "According to Carlile, the tour, which was originally set to start in October, has been pushed to March 2027. She didn't go into detail about the reason, but apologized to her fans for any inconvenience this may cause. In fact, she wrote on social media that she's been anxious about this decision, but hopes the rescheduling will give fans time to adjust their plans."
[Short music transition]
Host: "If you were planning on catching Carlile in Lisbon, we've got some bad news - that show has been canceled outright. But, on the bright side, two new dates have been added in Wolverhampton, England, and Copenhagen. And don't worry if you've already bought tickets to other shows - refunds will be issued for the canceled dates, and fans in England will get priority presale access to the new dates."
[Short music transition]
Host: "The good news is that this postponement only affects the UK and European leg - the US leg of the tour is still on track to start next week in Maine. That tour supports her eighth studio album, Returning to Myself. And, as a quick reminder, Carlile is one of the most decorated artists in Americana, with multiple Grammy wins and collaborations with legends like Joni Mitchell and Elton John."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "That's all for now, folks. We'll keep you updated on any more changes to Brandi Carlile's tour. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you in the next episode!"
